title: "Default Shell Versions Across Distributions"
---

# Default Shell Versions Across Distributions

* **Debian & Ubuntu:** `/bin/sh` points to **Dash** (Debian Almquist Shell), an ultra-fast, minimal POSIX shell. Any bashism in `#!/bin/sh` will fail!
* **Alpine Linux:** `/bin/sh` and `/bin/bash` (if not installed) point to **BusyBox Ash**.
* **Fedora, RHEL, CentOS, Arch:** `/bin/sh` is a symlink to **GNU Bash** running in POSIX compatibility mode.
